tokens.name: graphite-900
tokens.usage: Ground behind everything; the scene when there is no footage. Never a lighter neutral in the headset.

tokens.name: graphite-800
tokens.usage: Panel surface. In the headset it is drawn at 78% opacity with a top highlight and a bottom dark line.

tokens.name: graphite-700
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips and tabs at rest (gradient from graphite-600 to this).

tokens.name: graphite-600
tokens.usage: Top of a button bevel; hover surface.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Inset tracks, throttles, dial wells and the timeline lane: 45% black over the panel with an inner shadow.

tokens.name: rim
tokens.usage: 1 px top-edge highlight on panels and buttons (14% white). Gives the glass its edge.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and idle outlines (8% white).

tokens.name: chalk
tokens.usage: All readable text and readouts. Labels sit at 55% of this; never below 45% in the headset.

tokens.name: chalk-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary labels (55% chalk pre-mixed on graphite-800). 4.9:1 on graphite-800.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: THE accent: your hand is on it (active tab, selected chip, the control being dragged, the focused panel's top edge). Flat copper is for strokes and small marks; filled surfaces use the Satin or Polished finish below.

tokens.name: copper-satin-top
tokens.usage: Satin finish, stop 0%. Satin = any copper surface with text on it (active chip, active tab, primary button): gradient top to bottom #f4cfa8 0%, #e3a676 42%, #cd8a5b 62%, #e2a878 100%.

tokens.name: copper-satin-mid
tokens.usage: Satin finish, stop 42%.

tokens.name: copper-satin-low
tokens.usage: Satin finish, stop 62%: its darkest band. ink-on-copper on this is about 6.2:1 (Polished's dark band is 4.8:1, which is why text goes on Satin).

tokens.name: copper-polished-spec
tokens.usage: Polished finish, specular band. Polished = copper surfaces with no text (switch tracks, bar fills, throttle fills, the held dial and ring dot): #fbe3c8 0%, #eab389 20%, #cf8d5e 44%, #b97448 56%, #d99c6c 76%, #f3c79d 100%.

tokens.name: copper-polished-dark
tokens.usage: Polished finish, the dark band at 56% that makes it read as curved metal. Never put text on it.

tokens.name: copper-edge
tokens.usage: 1 px bottom edge of any copper surface (at 50–60%), with a 1 px white top edge at 60–70%.

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Resolve is telling you something: link, bitrate, render state, scopes graticule. Text with an icon, never a chip or a control.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The playhead, errors and destructive confirmations. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: ink-on-copper
tokens.usage: Text on a copper surface (Satin only).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows; panel inner padding on the short side.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding on the long side; gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Minimum pinch target (height of every button, knob hit box and tab). Not a layout step: a floor.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Timeline clips, tick marks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tabs, throttle knobs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switches, bar tracks, grab bars.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Every panel: rim light, base line, drop. No copper halo (removed 30 Oct).

tokens.name: bevel
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tabs at rest.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Tracks, throttles, dial wells, the timeline lane.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: Slider and throttle knobs, ring and arc dots.

tokens.name: active
tokens.usage: Any copper surface: white top edge, copper-edge bottom line, the normal drop. No glow (Nelson, 30 Oct: highlight, not halo).

tokens.name: rest
tokens.usage: Stereo elevation above the panel surface, in millimetres. A control at rest sits on the glass.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Pointed at: 2 mm proud of the panel (per-eye offset in the render).

tokens.name: drag
tokens.usage: Being dragged: 4 mm. The ceiling; more than this doubles 24 px text.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: A pressed button drops back to the surface for the duration of the press.
